text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · paging eng-oncall · alert: rl-api-95th-latency (service=redwood-api, region=us-west-2) triggered at 2024-06-13T08:00:00Z · symptom: 95p latency > 1200ms for 5m · incident id: INC-20240613-0423

Sam Li: acked. I’m on it, grabbing logs and tracing.

Sam Li: quick note — rolling fallback to cpu-backed model started to reduce queueing. invoked fallback policy: model-variant:v2->v1-fallback :zap:  (will monitor)

Priya Nair: thx. can you post short customer-impact estimate when you have it? pinging @Mateo for routing check.

Mateo Gomez: looking at router metrics now — a spike in KV cache miss rate around 07:57Z, correlated with a flurry of long sequences from internal load tests. not seeing backend OOMs.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot detected canary roll at 2024-06-13T07:55:12Z · commit: 9f2a3c2 · author: eng-runtime -> linked to INC-20240613-0423

Sam Li: suspected cause: recent change to KV eviction window in runtime (shorter TTL) + burst of long sequences caused cold KV misses and higher decode time. mitigation done: reverted eviction window on the routing layer and enabled prefix caching for hot customers.

Lena Park: customer impact: small subset of customers (~0.6% of requests) experienced >1s latency bump and a few 500s (~0.03% errors) — support ticket inbound from AcmeCorp. Sharing quick summary for CS.

Aaron Kim: can we suppress noisy alerts during mitigation? still getting a ton of pages because the 95p rule is too sensitive to bursts.

Sam Li: yes — I muted rl-api-95th-latency in PagerDuty for 30m to avoid pages while we validate the fix. Leaving the alert recording on so it still tracks in metrics.

Priya Nair: for follow-up: we should 1) tune the alert thresholds, 2) add a cache hit-rate dashboard, 3) update runbook to call out eviction window regressions. Assign owners?

Mateo Gomez: I can own alert tuning + dashboard. Proposed changes: raise 95p threshold from 1200ms -> 2000ms for bursts (use rolling 5m) and add a secondary alert for sustained >1500ms beyond 15m. Also add a new panel: kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate by model

Priya Nair: sounds good. add annotation to the runbook with link to the dashboard and the deploy that triggered it.

Sam Li: adding immediate runbook note now — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rl-api-latency. NOTE in runbook: "Aug 13 2024: temporary mitigation for KV eviction regression; owner: Mateo Gomez; related deploy: 9f2a3c2; follow-ups assigned."

Lena Park: can we add a small how-to snippet in the runbook for muting alerts without losing telemetry? new oncall often mutes and then we lose context.

Sam Li: adding snippet. here's the Prometheus rule we added to staging for the secondary alert (copy):

```
- alert: RLAPISustainedHighLatency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 1.5
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "95p sustained high latency for redwood-api"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rl-api-latency"
```

Mateo Gomez: thanks — I’ll commit dashboard + rule to infra-monitoring. assigning PR to @Priya for review and @Lena for doc update. ETA EOD PST.

Aaron Kim: for noise reduction, can we scope the primary alert to production-tenants only (exclude internal & staging load test tags)? we keep getting spikes from those.

Priya Nair: yes, good call. add `tenant=~"^(prod-).*"` filter to the alert query. Mateo, please make that change in the PR.

Mateo Gomez: will do. Also I’ll add a small playbook block: "If 95p spikes but cache_hit_rate > 80% then deprioritize paging — likely client-side long sequences".

Lena Park: runbook update checklist (adding now to the runbook page):
- summary of incident + root cause (KV eviction window)
- links: deploy 9f2a3c2, PRs for alert + dashboard, Prometheus rule snippet
- ownership: Mateo (alerts + dashboards), Lena (runbook updates), Sam (oncall mitigation & validation), Priya (postmortem lead)
- handoff instructions for next oncall: what to look at, how to revert fugitive changes

Sam Li: handing off to next oncall: @Aaron — I’ll leave the incident open with a short note on the rollback and mitigation steps. please monitor support tickets and escalate if errors exceed 0.1% or new spike > 2000ms.

Aaron Kim: acked. I’ve scheduled a reminder for 1hr to check the dashboard. will escalate if needed.

Priya Nair: making an action item list for follow-up postmortem session:
- create dashboard panel: kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate (owner: Mateo)
- update Prometheus alert rules: scope to prod tenants + add sustained alert (owner: Mateo)
- update runbook page with annotated timeline, links, and how-to for muting (owner: Lena)
- postmortem doc + blameless RCA (owner: Priya)

oncall-bot: NOTE: incident INC-20240613-0423 status changed to "monitoring" at 2024-06-13T09:00:00Z by Sam Li

Sam Li: closing notes: mitigation validated, customer impact limited, follow-ups assigned. moving to monitoring.

Aaron Kim: thanks all. logging this thread into the incident tracker and adding it to the postmortem agenda. :white_check_mark:
